layers, and more layers. keep your core warm and it'll make a difference. just about as important is keeping the head, neck, wrists and ankles warm. a crack in the armor can effect the whole of you.

i used to just use conventional themals as a base but the Underarmor base layer is pretty good.

I ride year round, almost. Only stop if there is ice on the road.
Make sure your outer layer is windproof. Most motorcycle jackets are. Then put layers under it. They do not have to be thick layers. I use a thin sweater, and a thicker one.

That is usually enough for the torso. For my legs, just regular jeans, and rain pants to break the wind.

The weakest point is my hands. Good thick gloves help. But nothing but electric heated gloves will get you more than a half hour on a highway if it is under 5c.

That's what works for me.

My jacket is mesh, so I put on a windbreaker under it (511 chameleon, great jacket)

Swap out my mechanix mpact gloves for some waterproof icon patrol gloves
